get.description:
Retained output without attaching. Chunks are whole: they come from `fromSeq` until the next would pass `maxBytes`, and at least one comes when any is retained. Read again from `nextSeq` while `truncated` is true. `gap` is `{requested, available}` when earlier output was dropped from the spool. Once `exited` is set, every byte of output is in the spool. A sandbox whose runner lacks this call answers 501 `E_UNSUPPORTED`.

Scope: `read`.

200.description: `{sessionId, chunks: [{seq, stream, data}], nextSeq, gap, truncated, exited}`.

400.description: An invalid body or query (`E_INVALID_PARAMS`) naming the first path.

401.description: A missing or invalid bearer token (`E_DENIED`).

403.description: The key lacks the scope, or a browser-originated request or foreign Host (`E_DENIED`).

404.description: No such resource, or one the key does not see.

429.description: Too many failed authentications from this address (`E_LIMIT`); see `Retry-After`.

default.description: Any other failure; see the error codes.
